r20_o3.question: does 'no painted source of an old page kept unread, painted_sources_kept empty' (proof.region_cleared) match the code
r20_o3.answer: No for the first clause, so it was corrected. The code decides region_cleared by painted_sources_kept alone (RedactedOutput::region_flattened requires it empty, sanitized_save.rs painted_sources_kept; drop_painted_sources returns every live painted source not in the silent set, flatten_purge.rs:963-964). 'Read' is not a code concept: a source a kept form or an annotation appearance reads is reported anyway (R18, R19), a source only referenced by a kept object is reached but not read and is reported, and a silent image is read (its Do is parsed) and not reported. The conjunction was exact only because of its second clause; the first clause described a condition the code never evaluates. Fix: first clause removed, second kept (the R20-O3 and R21 repair direction). Pinned by descriptor_states_the_painted_source_condition_and_the_purge_categories
